title: Estonian President makes farewell visit to Latvia
summary_full: On August 28th, President Edgars Rinkēvičs received Estonian President Alar Karis and his spouse Sirje Karis on a farewell visit to Latvia "in gratitude for their close cooperation and contribution to strengthening Latvian-Estonian relations," according to a release from the Latvian presidential chancellery.
